reviewProvenance.manualVisualComparison: The published model is a plain gray Nathan Drake sprinting with a pistol extended horizontally, stepping across a blocky wrecked machine bearing an engraved nameplate. The source statue shows Nathan jumping through ruins with arms raised, rope and rusty hanging cage framing the figure, skeletal remains and a fractured rock/boat-like environment, different leg and arm positions and different base objects. Multiple source angles 2–9 corroborate distinct sculpt geometry; the source character name alone does not prove same model.
reviewProvenance.identityProofInterpretation: Visual exclusion of the exact candidate based on pose, base and sculptural geometry. Candidate cover and source source-position bytes SHA-256 verified. This does not prove absence from all published or historical aliases.

mediaReview.notes: External source gallery includes logo overlays and promotional/render references; private staging 0/9. Companion bust or extras require independent identity and rights review. No import, watermark removal or display as new gallery media is authorized.
